'''Puffer turtles''' were a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Turtle/Legends|turtles]] found in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] ravaged by [[Nozho–Weogar War/Legends|biochemical warfare]]. Some of these turtles were [[Color/Legends|violet]]. The species possessed bladders which they could swell to a point that stretched the flexibility of their shells. When they exhaled from the bladders, it could produce a sound similar to a low note on a [[bassoon]].

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Band/Legends|band]] [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] incorporated the sounds made by a nearby puffer turtle, along with other animals, into the [[Music/Legends|music]] they played when they were in hiding from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization.<ref name="YJK:TOCC" />

==Behind the scenes==
A puffer turtle first appeared in [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]]'s [[1998]] book ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Trouble on Cloud City]]'', the thirteenth novel in the [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights|''Young Jedi Knights'']] series.<ref name="YJK:TOCC" />
